stayType: Family-run caravan and camping park with pods
accommodation: Grass pitches for tents, tourers and campervans (some with electric), camping pods, elite pod, shepherd's hut and a two-bedroom lodge
suitableFor: Families, campers and tourers; limited for dog owners
parking: One car per pitch included, extra car charged; units over 5m not accepted
dogs: Restricted: not allowed in high season (16 July–1 September) or in rental units; confirm with site
beachAccess: About 0.9 km to Croyde beach as the crow flies (Pitchup)
confirmedFeatures: Hot showers, family and accessible washrooms, laundry, playground, seasonal shop, takeaway and café, EV charging, Wi-Fi
overview: Bay View Farm is a family-run caravan and camping park on the edge of Croyde, overlooking the sea and a little under a kilometre from the beach. Alongside grass pitches there are camping pods, a shepherd's hut and a lodge, with a café, takeaway and play area on site.
surfTripFit: Walkable to Croyde beach and with a wetsuit washing area, it suits surfers camping on a budget; the high-season dog ban will rule it out for some.
gaps: Official site (bayviewfarm.co.uk) blocked fetching, so facts come from Pitchup only; Pitchup contradicts itself on pools and dogs. Season listed as 12 March–1 November 2026.
